title: Debiasing Large Language Models via Adaptive Causal Prompting with Sketch-of-Thought

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on complex reasoning and mathematical benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, HotpotQA, CommonsenseQA) by comparing standard prompting methods against causal prompting methods (front-door and conditional front-door adjustments) designed to block unobserved confounders and spurious correlations.

Evaluating fact verification accuracy using the Symmetric FEVER benchmark, which utilizes counterfactual claim-evidence pairs to expose and measure the model's reliance on claims without properly verifying the provided evidence.
